rules: Bash 3.2 compatible: no declare -A, no readarray, no ${var,,}, no ${var^^}
Pipeline stages source from scripts/lib/ — never call scripts directly from stages
All GitHub API calls guarded with [[ $NO_GITHUB != true ]]
JSON operations use jq with --arg for escaping, never string interpolation
Atomic file writes: write to tmp file then mv, not direct echo > file
cd in helper functions must use subshells to avoid changing caller directory
Every script has VERSION variable at top kept in sync with package.json
Event logging via emit_event for observability

never_ship: readarray or mapfile (not available in Bash 3.2)
grep -c under pipefail without || true (produces double output)
cmd | while read (loses variable state in subshell)
String interpolation in jq (injection risk — use --arg)
Direct echo > file without atomic tmp+mv pattern
GitHub API calls without NO_GITHUB guard
Hardcoded paths instead of using $SCRIPT_DIR or $REPO_DIR
git push --force to main or master
always_require: Source guard at top of library files: [[ -n ${_GUARD:-} ]] && return 0
ERR trap in test suites for debugging
PASS/FAIL counters in test suites with summary at end
Proper cleanup in test suites (trap cleanup EXIT)
Mock binaries in temp directory for test isolation
emit_event calls for key state transitions
info/success/warn/error output helpers for user-facing messages

focus_areas: Atomic file operations (race conditions in concurrent pipelines)
GitHub API error handling (rate limits, auth failures, missing repos)
Test isolation (mock binaries, temp dirs, no real API calls)
Context window efficiency (don't dump large outputs into prompts)
